rationale: Draft's claims about the known AMD driver issue (versions 25.10.2+, RX 5500 XT/7800 XT) and the workaround (roll back to 25.9.1) are grounded in chunks 1825727806709997-3 and 1811772772359267-1. However, the draft states 'flagged across multiple recent patches through Ver.1.041.01.00' — the chunks show the issue noted in Ver.1.041.01.00 and Ver.1.030.02.02 (a launch fix), but chunk 1823191198598921-26 (Ver.1.040.03.01) addresses a *different* issue (incorrect outdated-driver warning for 26.1.1+), not the 25.10.2+ problem. The draft over-claims that the 25.10.2+ issue was 'flagged across multiple recent patches' when only one patch (1.041.01.00) explicitly flags it in the pool.
